description: Why Fresh Roasted Coffee? Because it's not just a name. It's how we do business. Most orders are roasted the same night and shipped the next day. HOW TO VACUUM YOUR RUG - To vacuum your rug, use a canister vacuum without a beater bar a broom, or a manual sweeper. Upright vacuums with high suction power can pull threads from the rug's back and cause "sprouts." Use a handheld attachment if possible, or turn off the beater bar as it can pull fibers from the face of the rug and cause the rug to fuzz.
